extDescription.message: Browse with confidence: get instant alerts when a page or its resources, forms, or links don't use secure HTTPS.

enableUrlNotifications.message: Notify when the page does not use HTTPS
enableUrlNotifications.description: Label of the checkbox that toggles page URL notifications.

enableLinkNotifications.message: Notify when resources, forms or links do not use HTTPS
enableLinkNotifications.description: Label of the checkbox that toggles resource/form/link notifications.

issuePageNotHttps.message: The page does not use HTTPS.
issuePageNotHttps.description: Notification line shown when the page itself is not served over HTTPS.

checkNow.description: Label of the button that manually checks the active tab.

checkResultOk.message: Everything uses HTTPS on this page.
checkResultOk.description: Result shown when the manual check finds no issues.

checkNotPossible.description: Result shown when the active tab cannot be checked (e.g. browser pages).

resourcesNotChecked.message: The page resources could not be checked.
resourcesNotChecked.description: Result shown when the resource check failed on the active tab.

issueInsecureResources.message: $COUNT$ resource(s) (images, scripts, styles, frames…) load over HTTP.
issueInsecureResources.description: Notification line shown when resources loaded by the page (images, scripts, styles, frames, media) are not served over HTTPS.

issueInsecureForms.description: Notification line shown when forms on the page submit their data over HTTP.

issueInsecureLinks.description: Notification line shown when links on the page point to HTTP pages.

permissionNeeded.message: Automatic notifications need access to the sites you visit. The manual check works without it.
permissionNeeded.description: Notice in the popup (and icon tooltip) when automatic notifications are enabled but site access was not granted.

grantPermission.description: Button that asks Chrome for access to the sites.
